name: friendly_fire
_comment: Wave 10 item 0b: NPC friendly fire. In Kit FF Range the player (Kit Ring Tank, 30000/30000) takes off from the port; an anchored shooter (red disc) sits 260 px north and a victim (blue disc, shield 1000, no recharge, a 1-damage pea turret) 110 px north, on the line of fire. The original offers only ONE main-spaceport (AvailLoc 3) mission per landing (a bar mission did not show up and a second landing offered nothing), so the shooter is the spaceport offer and the victim a Mission BBS job (BBS button at window 182,430, Accept at 476,384, Leave at 579,384). Tab cycles victim / shooter / none with a window shot after each press (the target panel reads the victim's shield). Pilots: pilots/w10_ff_*.json.
